question: Peppara Wildlife Sanctuary is situated in which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Kerala.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Peppara Wildlife Sanctuary**__ 

 __
 
• **The Peppara Wildlife Sanctuary is a wildlife sanctuary in the Thiruvananthapuram district of Kerala, India.**
 
• The Sanctuary is named after the Peppara Dam, commissioned in 1983 to augment the drinking water supply to Thiruvananthapuram city and suburban areas.
 
• **It is part of the Agasthyamala Biosphere Reserve.**
 
• Peppara Wildlife Sanctuary is 44 kilometres by car from the nearest railway station, at Thiruvananthapuram, and 49 kilometres from the Thiruvananthapuram airport.
 
• The sanctuary has several mammals, birds, reptiles, and amphibians. The common mammals found are tiger, leopard, sloth bear, elephant, sambar, bonnet macaque, Nilgiri langur, Nilgiri tahr.
